written: 2026-10-17, after the local differential-evolution circuit run and before the globalMOO run
budget: One globalMOO model for the 5-node circuit (nerve, token, concept, pain, reader), trained once and queried for the 6 circuit goals in circuit.json, max 40 iterations each.
hypothesis: 'nerve' (L9/N3688+) has two parallel input routes: a Latin-script token route (L3/N6493) and a concept route (L8/N7756) carrying non-Latin scripts. The pain detector (L8/N3858) gates the token route; it may not gate the concept route. The reader (L10/N6901) depends on 'nerve'.

predictions.bypass: Satisfied only by passages using non-Latin 'nerve' (Arabic/CJK), with concept ≥ 0.5.
predictions.gated: Satisfied with pain ≥ 0.5 in the passage.
predictions.override: If satisfied, through the concept route (token low).
predictions.reader_other_routes: Not satisfiable within the bank (DE best 0.40).
predictions.efficiency: Fewer model evaluations than DE's 3,744 for the six goals.
